topic: Comet 67P looks like a rubber duck
hook: Your rubber duck has a twin floating in space.
title: A Real Comet That Looks Like a Rubber Duck
description:
Comet 67P, visited by the European Space Agency's Rosetta probe in 2014, has two lobes joined by a thin neck, so it looks like a rubber duck. Rosetta orbited it for about two years and sent down a lander named Philae.
